name: visual-ui-builder
description: Framework-independent UI component library using native Web Components

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/core && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/schema && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/components &&npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/renderer && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/builder
scripts.pack:packages: npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/core && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/components && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/renderer && npm run build --workspace=@visual-ui/schema && npm pack --workspace=@visual-ui/core --workspace=@visual-ui/components --workspace=@visual-ui/renderer --workspace=@visual-ui/schema --pack-destination release
